## History

Lauretta White was taken to church by her mother starting as a six-month-old infant and conducted herself irreproachably during services ever since. On a Sunday at church, her peaceful attendance was interrupted when [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) dropped a caterpillar down her neck. This unexpected incident created a commotion during the service.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P4](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0004), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P7](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0007), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008), +36 more_
